subject: DI03005021

body.en:
Definition and principle

A flowmeter determines volume or mass passing a section per unit time. Classify by principle before studying individual instruments: Differential-pressure devices include venturi and orifice meters; variable-area devices include rotameters; open-channel devices include weirs/notches; electromagnetic devices use induced voltage.

Important points

Selection depends on fluid phase, conductivity, viscosity, solids, flow range, accuracy, pressure loss, installation and calibration. Volume flow and mass flow are not interchangeable without density. Head loss is an operating cost, not merely a measurement signal. A device calibrated for water may not directly indicate the correct flow of another liquid or gas.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Section માંથી એકમ સમયમાં પસાર થતો volume અથવા mass માપતું instrument Flowmeter છે.Individual instruments પહેલાં principle પ્રમાણે વર્ગીકરણ કરો.Venturi તથા orifice differential-pressure devices છે.Rotameter variable-area, Weir/notch open-channel અને electromagnetic meter induced-voltage principle પર છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Fluid phase, conductivity, viscosity, solids, flow range, accuracy, pressure loss, installation તથા calibration પ્રમાણે selection કરો.Density વગર volume તથા mass flow interchangeable નથી.Head loss operating cost છે, ફક્ત measurement signal નહીં.Water માટે calibrated device બીજા liquid અથવા gas માટે સીધું સાચું indication આપે એવું જરૂરી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A venturi meter measures flow from the pressure difference between a larger inlet and a reduced throat.

Construction

It consists of a converging section, cylindrical throat and gradual diverging diffuser. Pressure taps at specified sections connect to a differential manometer/transmitter. The bore and tap dimensions define its calibration.

Working and applications

Liquid accelerates in the converging passage, so throat static pressure falls. The measured differential and continuity/Bernoulli relation give a theoretical flow; Cd corrects to calibrated actual flow. The diffuser slows the stream and recovers part of the pressure, but permanent loss remains. It is useful where pressure recovery and lower loss justify greater size/cost. Assume constant density only when appropriate; use straight-run/tap requirements and avoid trapped air in liquid impulse lines.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

મોટા inlet તથા reduced throat વચ્ચેના pressure difference પરથી flow માપતું instrument Venturi Meter છે.

રચના (Construction)

Converging section, cylindrical throat તથા gradual diverging diffuser તેના parts છે.Specified sections ના pressure taps differential manometer/transmitter સાથે જોડાય છે.Bore તથા tap dimensions calibration નક્કી કરે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Converging passage માં liquid accelerate થાય છે અને throat static pressure ઘટે છે.Measured differential તથા continuity/Bernoulli પરથી theoretical flow મળે છે.Cd થી calibrated actual flow મળે છે.Diffuser stream ધીમું કરીને pressure નો ભાગ recover કરે છે, પણ permanent loss રહે છે.ઓછા loss તથા recovery માટે વધારાનું size/cost સ્વીકાર્ય હોય ત્યાં ઉપયોગી છે.Constant-density assumption યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે જ લો.Straight-run/tap requirements અનુસરો અને liquid impulse lines માં trapped air ટાળો.

મૂળ સંબંધ

body.en:
Definition

An orifice meter measures flow using the differential pressure created by a restriction plate.

Construction

A thin plate with a specified sharp-edged opening is fitted between pipe flanges or in an approved holder. Upstream/downstream taps are placed according to the selected standard geometry and connect to a differential instrument.

Working and applications

The stream accelerates through the opening and contracts into a vena contracta before re-expanding. The tap-pressure difference is related to flow by a geometry/Re-dependent discharge coefficient; the plate area is not automatically the minimum jet area. It is compact, economical and replaceable, but usually causes higher permanent loss than a venturi. Damaged edges, deposits, tap errors and unsuitable flow profiles change calibration. The displayed equation is for incompressible flow, not an uncorrected gas formula.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Restriction plate થી બનતા differential pressure પરથી flow માપતું instrument Orifice Meter છે.

રચના (Construction)

Specified sharp-edged opening વાળી thin plate flanges વચ્ચે અથવા approved holder માં ગોઠવાય છે.Selected standard geometry મુજબ upstream/downstream taps differential instrument સાથે જોડાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Opening માં stream accelerate થઈ vena contracta માં contract થાય છે અને પછી re-expand થાય છે.Tap-pressure difference થી geometry/Re-dependent discharge coefficient વડે flow મળે છે.Plate area હંમેશાં minimum jet area નથી.Compact, economical તથા replaceable છે, પણ સામાન્ય રીતે venturi કરતાં permanent loss વધુ હોય છે.Damaged edge, deposits, tap errors તથા ખરાબ flow profile calibration બદલે છે.દર્શાવેલું equation incompressible flow માટે છે; uncorrected gas formula નહીં.

મૂળ સંબંધ

body.en:
Definition

A rotameter is a variable-area meter with a float moving in a vertically mounted tube that widens upward.

Construction

A scale indicates float height, and stops retain the float. Separate inlet/outlet connections impose upward flow; the float/tube/materials are selected for the process fluid and pressure.

Working and applications

Upward fluid drag plus buoyancy balances float weight. At a higher flow the float rises to a larger annular area until force balance is restored. Thus height indicates flow for the specified calibration. Differential pressure associated with supporting the float is approximately constant in the simplified model, not every pressure loss in the complete instrument. Install vertically with free float motion. Read the designated float reference point; density, viscosity and gas operating pressure/temperature can require corrections. There is no universal rotameter discharge coefficient independent of its float/tube model. Here ρf and Vf are float density and volume;ρ is fluid density; W, B and FD are weight, buoyancy and drag.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rotameter variable-area meter છે, જેમાં vertically mounted ઉપર પહોળી થતી tube માં float ખસે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Scale float height બતાવે છે અને stops float ને retain કરે છે.Flow નીચેના inlet થી ઉપરના outlet તરફ છે.Float/tube/materials process fluid તથા pressure માટે યોગ્ય પસંદ થાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Upward fluid drag તથા buoyancy, float ના weight ને balance કરે છે.Flow વધતાં float વધુ annular area સુધી ઊંચો જાય છે અને force balance ફરી બને છે.તેથી specified calibration માટે height પરથી flow મળે છે.Simplified model માં float support માટેનું differential pressure આશરે constant છે, આખા instrument નું દરેક loss નહીં.Vertically install કરો અને float motion free રાખો.Designated float reference point વાંચો.Density, viscosity તથા gas operating pressure/temperature માટે corrections જરૂરી હોઈ શકે છે.Universal rotameter discharge coefficient નથી.અહીં ρf તથા Vf float ની density તથા volume છે;ρ fluid density છે; W, B તથા FD એટલે weight, buoyancy તથા drag.

મૂળ સંબંધ

body.en:
Definition

A weir is an overflow barrier used to measure open-channel discharge.

Construction

A notch is a shaped opening in a plate; common forms are rectangular and triangular(V-notch).A sharp crest/edge, upstream head-measurement point and free aerated nappe are specified. The receiving channel must not submerge the crest for the simple free-flow formula.

Working and applications

Upstream head determines the ideal velocity through strips of the opening; integration gives discharge as a power of head. Cd accounts for nonideal flow under the defined geometry. Measure head at the specified upstream location, not the curved drawdown surface at the crest. A rectangular opening suits a broad flow range; a V-notch gives greater head sensitivity at small flows. Approach velocity, end contraction and submergence require the appropriate corrections; the basic formulas below neglect them.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Open-channel discharge માપવા overflow barrier ને Weir કહે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Plate ની shaped opening Notch છે.Rectangular તથા triangular(V-notch) સામાન્ય forms છે.Sharp crest/edge, upstream head-measurement point તથા free aerated nappe જરૂરી છે.Simple free-flow formula માટે receiving channel થી crest submerge ન થવો જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Upstream head પરથી opening ના strips માં ideal velocity મળે છે.Integration થી discharge, head ના power તરીકે મળે છે.Cd defined geometry માટે nonideal flow account કરે છે.Head specified upstream point પર માપો, crest પાસેના curved drawdown પર નહીં.Rectangular opening broad flow range માટે અને V-notch small flows પર વધુ sensitivity માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Approach velocity, end contraction તથા submergence માટે યોગ્ય corrections લો.નીચેના basic formulas માં આ effects neglected છે.

body.en:
Definition

An electromagnetic flowmeter measures a conductive fluid using Faraday induction.

Construction

A flow tube has an electrically insulating liner, magnetic-field coils and a pair of sensing electrodes placed across the induced-voltage direction. The field, flow and electrode directions are mutually arranged as required; the tube must remain suitably full.

Working and applications

Conductive liquid moving through the magnetic field develops electrode voltage proportional to mean velocity in the calibrated geometry. The transmitter converts voltage to velocity and multiplies by area for volume flow. It has no intrusive primary obstruction and can suit conductive slurries, subject to electrode/liner compatibility. It does not ordinarily measure dry gases or nonconductive oils. Grounding, minimum conductivity, electrode condition and an empty-pipe fault require attention.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electromagnetic Flowmeter conductive fluid માટે Faraday induction principle વાપરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Flow tube માં electrically insulating liner, magnetic coils તથા induced-voltage direction માં sensing electrodes હોય છે.Field, flow તથા electrode directions યોગ્ય રીતે ગોઠવાય છે.Tube યોગ્ય રીતે full રહેવી જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Magnetic field માંથી પસાર થતા conductive liquid માં electrode voltage બને છે, જે calibrated geometry માં mean velocity ને proportional છે.Transmitter voltage પરથી velocity તથા area વડે volume flow કાઢે છે.Primary intrusive obstruction નથી અને compatible liner/electrode હોય તો conductive slurries માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Dry gases અથવા nonconductive oils માટે સામાન્ય રીતે કામ કરતું નથી.Grounding, minimum conductivity, electrode condition તથા empty-pipe fault ધ્યાનમાં લો.

Aim and principle

Compare independently measured actual flow with the incompressible theoretical differential-pressure flow for the actual geometry.

Apparatus and connections

Venturi rig, known pipe/opening diameters, correctly located pressure taps, differential instrument and independent calibrated collection/time measurement.

Supervised procedure

Check tap connections and zero; establish permitted steady flow. Record both levels/pressures and independent volume/time. Convert manometer displacement using both fluid densities and tap elevations. Calculate Qtheory with Cd=1, then Cd=Qactual/Qtheory. Repeat without inventing a single universal coefficient.

Aim and principle

Apparatus and connections

Supervised procedure

Check vertical alignment, free float and correct reading edge/centre. Set approved stable flows and record indicated and reference flow. Include fluid identity/temperature and gas pressure corrections if relevant. Plot Qreference versus Qindicated; label any Cd definition explicitly.

body.en:
Task, report and evidence

body.gu:
Task, Report તથા Evidence

Venturi, orifice, rotameter, weirs તથા magnetic meters માં calibration, conductivity/phase limitations તથા pressure loss સમજાવો. Group માં આશરે 5pages નો report બનાવો: objective/principle, labelled chart/model અથવા method, comparison/calculations, findings/safety તથા conclusion/references.ફક્ત genuine permitted photos, readings તથા presentation evidence જોડો.

title.gu: Venturi meter:pressure difference plus recovery—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર
Orifice meter:tap geometry defines calibration—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર

title.en: Rotameter:upward flow in a widening vertical tube
title.gu: Rotameter:upward flow in a widening vertical tube—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર
Magnetic flowmeter:field,flow and electrode directions—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર

q.en: State the definition/principle of Classification of flow-measuring devices.
q.gu: Flow-measuring Devices નું વર્ગીકરણ ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A flowmeter determines volume or mass passing a section per unit time. Classify by principle before studying individual instruments: Differential-pressure devices include venturi and orifice meters; variable-area devices include rotameters; open-channel devices include weirs/notches; electromagnetic devices use induced voltage. Selection depends on fluid phase, conductivity, viscosity, solids, flow range, accuracy, pressure loss, installation and calibration. Volume flow and mass flow are not interchangeable without density. Head loss is an operating cost, not merely a measurement signal. A device calibrated for water may not directly indicate the correct flow of another liquid or gas.
a.gu: Section માંથી એકમ સમયમાં પસાર થતો volume અથવા mass માપતું instrument Flowmeter છે.Individual instruments પહેલાં principle પ્રમાણે વર્ગીકરણ કરો.Venturi તથા orifice differential-pressure devices છે.Rotameter variable-area, Weir/notch open-channel અને electromagnetic meter induced-voltage principle પર છે. Fluid phase, conductivity, viscosity, solids, flow range, accuracy, pressure loss, installation તથા calibration પ્રમાણે selection કરો.Density વગર volume તથા mass flow interchangeable નથી.Head loss operating cost છે, ફક્ત measurement signal નહીં.Water માટે calibrated device બીજા liquid અથવા gas માટે સીધું સાચું indication આપે એવું જરૂરી નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Venturi meter.
q.gu: Venturi Meter ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A venturi meter measures flow from the pressure difference between a larger inlet and a reduced throat. It consists of a converging section, cylindrical throat and gradual diverging diffuser. Pressure taps at specified sections connect to a differential manometer/transmitter. The bore and tap dimensions define its calibration. Liquid accelerates in the converging passage, so throat static pressure falls. The measured differential and continuity/Bernoulli relation give a theoretical flow; Cd corrects to calibrated actual flow. The diffuser slows the stream and recovers part of the pressure, but permanent loss remains. It is useful where pressure recovery and lower loss justify greater size/cost. Assume constant density only when appropriate; use straight-run/tap requirements and avoid trapped air in liquid impulse lines.
a.gu: મોટા inlet તથા reduced throat વચ્ચેના pressure difference પરથી flow માપતું instrument Venturi Meter છે. Converging section, cylindrical throat તથા gradual diverging diffuser તેના parts છે.Specified sections ના pressure taps differential manometer/transmitter સાથે જોડાય છે.Bore તથા tap dimensions calibration નક્કી કરે છે. Converging passage માં liquid accelerate થાય છે અને throat static pressure ઘટે છે.Measured differential તથા continuity/Bernoulli પરથી theoretical flow મળે છે.Cd થી calibrated actual flow મળે છે.Diffuser stream ધીમું કરીને pressure નો ભાગ recover કરે છે, પણ permanent loss રહે છે.ઓછા loss તથા recovery માટે વધારાનું size/cost સ્વીકાર્ય હોય ત્યાં ઉપયોગી છે.Constant-density assumption યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે જ લો.Straight-run/tap requirements અનુસરો અને liquid impulse lines માં trapped air ટાળો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Orifice meter.
q.gu: Orifice Meter ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An orifice meter measures flow using the differential pressure created by a restriction plate. A thin plate with a specified sharp-edged opening is fitted between pipe flanges or in an approved holder. Upstream/downstream taps are placed according to the selected standard geometry and connect to a differential instrument. The stream accelerates through the opening and contracts into a vena contracta before re-expanding. The tap-pressure difference is related to flow by a geometry/Re-dependent discharge coefficient; the plate area is not automatically the minimum jet area. It is compact, economical and replaceable, but usually causes higher permanent loss than a venturi. Damaged edges, deposits, tap errors and unsuitable flow profiles change calibration. The displayed equation is for incompressible flow, not an uncorrected gas formula.
a.gu: Restriction plate થી બનતા differential pressure પરથી flow માપતું instrument Orifice Meter છે. Specified sharp-edged opening વાળી thin plate flanges વચ્ચે અથવા approved holder માં ગોઠવાય છે.Selected standard geometry મુજબ upstream/downstream taps differential instrument સાથે જોડાય છે. Opening માં stream accelerate થઈ vena contracta માં contract થાય છે અને પછી re-expand થાય છે.Tap-pressure difference થી geometry/Re-dependent discharge coefficient વડે flow મળે છે.Plate area હંમેશાં minimum jet area નથી.Compact, economical તથા replaceable છે, પણ સામાન્ય રીતે venturi કરતાં permanent loss વધુ હોય છે.Damaged edge, deposits, tap errors તથા ખરાબ flow profile calibration બદલે છે.દર્શાવેલું equation incompressible flow માટે છે; uncorrected gas formula નહીં.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Rotameter.
q.gu: Rotameter ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A rotameter is a variable-area meter with a float moving in a vertically mounted tube that widens upward. A scale indicates float height, and stops retain the float. Separate inlet/outlet connections impose upward flow; the float/tube/materials are selected for the process fluid and pressure. Upward fluid drag plus buoyancy balances float weight. At a higher flow the float rises to a larger annular area until force balance is restored. Thus height indicates flow for the specified calibration. Differential pressure associated with supporting the float is approximately constant in the simplified model, not every pressure loss in the complete instrument. Install vertically with free float motion. Read the designated float reference point; density, viscosity and gas operating pressure/temperature can require corrections. There is no universal rotameter discharge coefficient independent of its float/tube model. Here ρf and Vf are float density and volume;ρ is fluid density; W, B and FD are weight, buoyancy and drag.
a.gu: Rotameter variable-area meter છે, જેમાં vertically mounted ઉપર પહોળી થતી tube માં float ખસે છે. Scale float height બતાવે છે અને stops float ને retain કરે છે.Flow નીચેના inlet થી ઉપરના outlet તરફ છે.Float/tube/materials process fluid તથા pressure માટે યોગ્ય પસંદ થાય છે. Upward fluid drag તથા buoyancy, float ના weight ને balance કરે છે.Flow વધતાં float વધુ annular area સુધી ઊંચો જાય છે અને force balance ફરી બને છે.તેથી specified calibration માટે height પરથી flow મળે છે.Simplified model માં float support માટેનું differential pressure આશરે constant છે, આખા instrument નું દરેક loss નહીં.Vertically install કરો અને float motion free રાખો.Designated float reference point વાંચો.Density, viscosity તથા gas operating pressure/temperature માટે corrections જરૂરી હોઈ શકે છે.Universal rotameter discharge coefficient નથી.અહીં ρf તથા Vf float ની density તથા volume છે;ρ fluid density છે; W, B તથા FD એટલે weight, buoyancy તથા drag.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Weirs and notches—rectangular and V-notch.
q.gu: Weirs તથા Notches—Rectangular અને V-notch ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A weir is an overflow barrier used to measure open-channel discharge. A notch is a shaped opening in a plate; common forms are rectangular and triangular(V-notch).A sharp crest/edge, upstream head-measurement point and free aerated nappe are specified. The receiving channel must not submerge the crest for the simple free-flow formula. Upstream head determines the ideal velocity through strips of the opening; integration gives discharge as a power of head. Cd accounts for nonideal flow under the defined geometry. Measure head at the specified upstream location, not the curved drawdown surface at the crest. A rectangular opening suits a broad flow range; a V-notch gives greater head sensitivity at small flows. Approach velocity, end contraction and submergence require the appropriate corrections; the basic formulas below neglect them.
a.gu: Open-channel discharge માપવા overflow barrier ને Weir કહે છે. Plate ની shaped opening Notch છે.Rectangular તથા triangular(V-notch) સામાન્ય forms છે.Sharp crest/edge, upstream head-measurement point તથા free aerated nappe જરૂરી છે.Simple free-flow formula માટે receiving channel થી crest submerge ન થવો જોઈએ. Upstream head પરથી opening ના strips માં ideal velocity મળે છે.Integration થી discharge, head ના power તરીકે મળે છે.Cd defined geometry માટે nonideal flow account કરે છે.Head specified upstream point પર માપો, crest પાસેના curved drawdown પર નહીં.Rectangular opening broad flow range માટે અને V-notch small flows પર વધુ sensitivity માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Approach velocity, end contraction તથા submergence માટે યોગ્ય corrections લો.નીચેના basic formulas માં આ effects neglected છે.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Rectangular sharp-crested weir—derivation.
q.gu: Rectangular Sharp-crested Weir—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Free, ventilated nappe; negligible approach velocity; constant width b and constant empirical Cd over the considered head range; y is depth below upstream free surface, H is total head above crest.
a.gu: Free, ventilated nappe; approach velocity negligible; opening width b constant તથા considered range માં empirical Cd constant છે.y upstream free surface થી નીચે depth અને H crest ઉપર total head છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Magnetic flowmeter.
q.gu: Magnetic Flowmeter ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An electromagnetic flowmeter measures a conductive fluid using Faraday induction. A flow tube has an electrically insulating liner, magnetic-field coils and a pair of sensing electrodes placed across the induced-voltage direction. The field, flow and electrode directions are mutually arranged as required; the tube must remain suitably full. Conductive liquid moving through the magnetic field develops electrode voltage proportional to mean velocity in the calibrated geometry. The transmitter converts voltage to velocity and multiplies by area for volume flow. It has no intrusive primary obstruction and can suit conductive slurries, subject to electrode/liner compatibility. It does not ordinarily measure dry gases or nonconductive oils. Grounding, minimum conductivity, electrode condition and an empty-pipe fault require attention.
a.gu: Electromagnetic Flowmeter conductive fluid માટે Faraday induction principle વાપરે છે. Flow tube માં electrically insulating liner, magnetic coils તથા induced-voltage direction માં sensing electrodes હોય છે.Field, flow તથા electrode directions યોગ્ય રીતે ગોઠવાય છે.Tube યોગ્ય રીતે full રહેવી જોઈએ. Magnetic field માંથી પસાર થતા conductive liquid માં electrode voltage બને છે, જે calibrated geometry માં mean velocity ને proportional છે.Transmitter voltage પરથી velocity તથા area વડે volume flow કાઢે છે.Primary intrusive obstruction નથી અને compatible liner/electrode હોય તો conductive slurries માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Dry gases અથવા nonconductive oils માટે સામાન્ય રીતે કામ કરતું નથી.Grounding, minimum conductivity, electrode condition તથા empty-pipe fault ધ્યાનમાં લો.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Venturi meter flow-rate equation—derivation.
q.gu: Venturi meter Flow-rate Equation—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Steady, horizontal, incompressible flow; uniform-section velocity model; ideal Bernoulli before calibrated Cd correction. D is pipe diameter, d is throat diameter. Tap geometry is fixed.
a.gu: Steady, horizontal, incompressible flow; uniform-section velocity model; calibrated Cd correction પહેલાં ideal Bernoulli લો.D pipe diameter અને d throat diameter છે.Tap geometry fixed છે.

q.gu: Orifice meter Flow-rate Equation—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.
